biography.value: Wonderbringers are lively performers who turn their magic to protecting the wilds when the need arises.

description.value: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Charmed apply=false] or &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] condition (pixie's choice) until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDancingLig]{Dancing Lights}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDruidcraft]{Druidcraft}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility} (self only)

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectThou]{Detect Thoughts}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFly0000000]{Fly}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMajorImage]{Major Image}

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplEntangle00]{Entangle}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPolymorph0]{Polymorph}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplTashasHide]{Hideous Laughter}, requiring no Material components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
